Commentary.Commentary: It looks like a decent total on the board but not something with which Pakistan can relax. The surface is batting friendly and in spite of lesser experience in the Lankan batting line-up, you can expect the young guns to fire and prove their mettle. Should be an exciting chase. Do join us in a short while.

Sri Lanka's bowling wasn't too good or too bad! They maintained a tight hold right from the beginning and even in the middle, they managed to keep the scoring rate under check. Towards the end though, they lost the plot and conceded runs at a rapid pace. Shehan Jayasuriya was brilliant as he bowled tidily while his spin partner, Wanindu Hasaranga claimed the wickets of the Pakistani openers.

Opting to bat on a placid looking surface, the Pakistan openers provided a solid start. Fakhar Zaman looked in good touch but failed to convert his start. Babar Azam batting at number 3 lived up to the expectation of the Karachi crowd and stroked a fluent century, his second in the last five innings. He constituted a century stand with Haris Sohail but it was a bit on the slower side and then they failed to kick on towards the end. The fall of Babar Azam's wicket in the 46th over hampered their charge somewhat but eventually a flourishing end by Iftikhar Ahmed powered them to 305/7!
54 runs in the last five overs and Pakistan got the desired finish at the death! Iftikhar Ahmed played a handy cameo towards the end to lift the home side's total past the 300-run mark.

OUT! RUN OUT but two runs also! Pradeep goes back to bowling it very full and on the pads. It is whipped through mid-wicket. They take two. Wahab wants a third but Iftikhar is not interested. The fielder throws it to the bowler who whips the bails off. A huge last over for Pakistan. 20 runs and a wicket from it. Due to that, the Pakistan team has crossed the 300-run mark. THEY END WITH 305/7!

SIX! 300 up in style for Pakistan! Another big hit. Pradeep has been taken to the cleaners in the last over. Not sure why is he going for the slower ones when he can bowl such good yorkers! This is another off pace ball. It is on middle. Iftikhar lofts it over the long on fence.
Top class delivery! A yorker on the pads, Wahab looks to whip it but misses to get hit on the pads. A leg bye is stolen.
Just a single! This is full and on off, Ahmed hits it down to long off for one. This too was in the slot but Iftikhar could not get under it.
SIX! 10 from the first two balls. Longest part of the fence and Iftikhar clears it. A slower one on middle, Ahmed shuffles across and then heaves it. It just crosses the mid-wicket fence.
FOUR LEG BYES! Ideal start to the last over. A very full ball on the pads. Ahmed looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. It rolls past the diving keeper and into the fine leg fence.

DROPPED! A good effort though but that should have been taken! Wahab Riaz stands covering his stumps. Udana bowls it short and on middle. Wahab looks to help it on its way to the fine leg fence. It goes uppishly towards short fine leg. Pradeep dives to his right, gets two hands to it but fails to hang on. Two taken by the batters. 9 runs and a wicket from this over. 15 short from reaching 300. 6 balls to go.
A yorker on middle, IA works it towards square leg for one.
FOUR! Muscled! Excellent shot. This is another slower one outside off. Iftikhar waits for it and then hammers it over covers for a boundary. A much-needed one.
Wahab Riaz is the next batsman in.

OUT! In the air... taken! Another one bites the dust. Good bowling from Udana. He continues bowling to his field and gets the reward. This is short and outside off, Wasim throws his bat at it but fails to middle his shot. He ends up carving it towards deep point where Oshada Fernando takes it easily. 300 now looks farfetched here.
Slower one outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
A slower full ball outside off, Wasim gets into position early to play the sweep but has to drag it from outside off. He hits it towards square leg for one.
A single to end! So despite the boundary, just the 7 from the over. Wasim comes down the track but it is short. He slaps it towards cover for one.
Top class delivery! A yorker on middle, Imad only jams it back to the bowler.

Just short and FOUR! Full and outside off, Imad once again mistimes it towards long off. Udana there has a second to decide whether to go for the catch or to stay back and stop it. He goes for the catch. Runs in and dives ahead. The ball though lands just short. He fails to stop it too and it goes to the fence behind.
A yorker on middle, this is jammed out towards mid on for one. Top three balls to begin with.
A back of the hand slower one on middle, Iftikhar is foxed by it and hence keeps it out. A dot, gold dust.
A full one on off, Imad Wasim chips it well short of long off for one.
Nuwan Pradeep is back into the attack. 7-0-37-0 his figures so far.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Dark clouds are forming around the stadium and the breeze is also picking up. We don't want any rain, please.
FOUR! Shot! Well timed by Imad. A low full toss, Wasim kneels and fetches it from outside off before nailing it behind square leg for a cracking boundary.
Slower cutter around leg, Ahmed sweeps it to short fine leg and collects a single.
A full toss this time. Outside off, Iftikhar throws his bat at it but fails to connect. Dots after dots after dots. Building pressure, Udana.
Short third man in place and he is standing quite straight than the usual position.
Wide! Isuru sprays this one way wide outside off. A comfortable leave for the batsman and the umpire exercises his arms.
On a length and around off, angling away, Ahmed drives it on the up but finds the extra cover fielder inside the ring. Two dots.
Slower one, fuller in length and on middle, Iftikhar defends it back from the crease.
A single to end as this is hit down to long off for one.
Imad Wasim is the new man in.

OUT! Babar Azam holes out! End of an outstanding innings from the Pakistan batter. A standing ovation for him as he walks back and a well-deserved one. This one looked like a tired shot. Kumara bowls it full and on middle, this was there to be hit. Azam looks to heave but does not get it in the middle. He gets more height than distance and Hasaranga at deep mid-wicket runs in, takes it on the second attempt. Important wicket as Azam could have really made a difference of at least 15 runs to the final total.

A direct hit and it has been taken upstairs! Replays show that Azam is safe! Two leg byes in the end! Slower and short on the pads, Azam looks to pull but misses. The ball brushes the pads and goes to the left of the keeper who dives and gets a hand to it. Azam is late in taking off. The fielder picks the ball up and hits the stumps at the bowler's end. An appeal but the umpire waits as the ball then rolls towards long on and the batters take another. Now it is taken upstairs and replays show that the batter is in.
Very full again, Iftikhar hits it well but straight towards long off for one.
Shuffles across again and then works it but towards deep mid-wicket for one.

SIX! That is some hit by Azam. This guy has wrists of steel. This is very full, difficult to get under those. Azam though somehow does so and whips it over the long on fence for a biggie. A maximum on the first ball, pressure on the bowler.

EDGY FOUR! Pakistan won't care how they come as long as they come. This is full and wide outside off, Ahmed throws his bat at it. The ball flies off the outside edge and down to the third man fence. The last ball spoils the over. 9 from it.
Deft! Slower one outside off, Iftikhar waits for it and then guides it down towards third man. The fielder at deep backward point runs to his left, dives and saves two for his side.
Good change in pace there! Udana bowls this seam-up and it ends up being a full toss outside off. Iftikhar is surprised by the pace and is hence, late on the shot.
Just the single! Shorter and outside off, another slower one. Azam waits for it and guides it through cover-point for one.
Excellent delivery! A yorker outside off, not a lot Azam could do there. This time, he fails to get bat on ball.
WIDE! Way too wide outside off, it is left alone.
Slightly fuller, Iftikhar strokes it down to long off for one.
Iftikhar Ahmed is the next batsman in.

OUT! Direct hit and Sarfaraz is way, way out. Another run out for the Lankans. Thirimanne, the skipper, produces brilliance in the field. This is fuller again, Ahmed strokes it towards cover and sets off. Thirimanne picks the ball up and scores a bull's eye at the non-striker's end. Sarfaraz continues running to the pavilion. End of an action-packed over, 9 runs and a wicket.
Fuller and on off, this is hit to mid off. A dot.
A single now as this is driven square on the off side.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! 8 from the first three balls. Easy again. Short and on the body, Azam swivels and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary.

FOUR! 100 for Pakistan's best batsman. 11th ODI ton. Second in his last 5 innings. He gets there in style. Kumara bowls it full and outside off, Azam drives it square on the off side, past the diving point fielder and into the fence. A sedate celebration by him. Time to up the ante now.
Back of a length on off, Azam pushes it to covers.
Lahiru Kumara is back! 8-0-41-0 his figures so far.
Very full and on off, Sarfaraz strokes it down towards long off. The fielder there runs to his right, fumbles and hence, the batters take two.
Moves onto 98 as he pushes this one down to long off for one.
One more slower one, Sarfaraz looks to go very hard at it but ends up mistiming it towards long off for one.
Good length again and on off, Sarfaraz strokes it back towards the bowler. Udana dives to his right and stops it nicely.
Slightly fuller and on off, Sarfaraz strokes it wide of long off for two.
Shorter and around off, Ahmed guides it towards point. He wants a run but is sent back.
Isuru Udana is back into the attack. 5-0-29-0 his figures so far.
Sprays a fuller one on the pads, Sarfaraz helps it behind square leg for one. 8 coming from this over.
Slower delivery on a length around off, it's punched down to long on for a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Straighter delivery, Sarfaraz clips it in the gap at mid-wicket for one.
The batsman delicately works it fine down the leg side. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Poor delivery. A length ball angling down the leg side, Azam goes for the flick shot but fails to middle it properly. It takes a thin edge as it flies behind. Samarawickrama dives across to his left but fails to hold on to the catch. It races away to the fine leg fence. Technically a dropped catch!
Floated and on off, driven through the line and the extra fielder failed to get around to make the stop. A single is taken. 10-0-63-2, Wanindu has bowled out!
Loopy and full outside off, Babar tries to push it towards covers and run immediately. But it has gone quickly to the fielder and Sarfaraz sends his partner back.
Shortish and on middle, defended from the back foot to the leg side.
Hasaranga drags his length short on middle, Babar pulls but finds the short mid-wicket fielder.
A googly landing full outside off, Sarfaraz lunges and pushes it with soft hands to covers for a quick run. Opens his account.
Floated delivery, landing full on middle, Azam drives it through mid off and collects a single.
Powerplay 3 begins! Now, a maximum of five fielders can drop outside the circle till the end of the innings.
On a length and around off, kept out. End of a successful over for Pakistan.
This one is angled into the batter. Ahmed looks to drive but misses to get hit on the pads.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
On off, this is blocked.
Sarfaraz Ahmed is the new batsman in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Haris Sohail is furious as he walks back. Rightly so too, it was his call as he was running towards the danger end but Azam is not interested at all. Nelson strikes as the stand comes to an end on 111. Also, this is probably the only way this could have ended as both were looking at ease. Nuwan Pradeep bowls a length ball around off, Azam looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls to the right of the keeper. Haris wants a run and rushes towards the other end. He is halfway down the track when Azam sends him back. The keeper picks the ball up and fires it to the bowler who collects it, turns and then throws it powerfully from close range at the stumps at his end. Haris is well short. He slams his bat on the ground as he walks back. Falls 10 short of a fifty. Sri Lanka need to keep taking wickets if they are to keep Pakistan in check.
On the pads, Sohail works it through mid-wicket for one.
Nuwan Pradeep is back on! He will bowl the last over of the Powerplay 2.
Two dots to end! Shorter and on middle, Azam goes back and pushes it to the bowler.
The slider on middle, this is hit back to the bowler.
Loopy ball and on off, Azam creams it through covers and takes two.
Floats it up on middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
FOUR! Lovely use of the feet and excellently played! Haris comes down the track and also makes room. He makes it into a half volley and creams it through extra cover for a boundary.
Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one. Jayasuriya finishes his spell with figures of 10-1-48-0. It has been a decent spell of bowling from him.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
BA comes down the track but this is bowled short. He mistimes it towards long on for one. The 100-run stand comes up between Babar Azam and Haris Sohail. They have laid the platform for a big score.
On middle, Azam works it to mid-wicket.
Fires it on middle, this is pushed towards cover for a quick run.
Very full and on middle, this is whipped down to long on for one.
Flighted and outside off, it's driven through covers for one.
A googly on the pads, it's hit through square leg for a single. 200 comes up for Pakistan in the 37th over!
Nicely tossed up ball on off, Sohail goes on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
Goes on the back foot to a short ball and cuts it to deep point for one.
Loopy and full on middle, Haris brings down a straight bat and pushes it past the bowler. The mid off fielder moves across to his left to cut off the ball and the batsmen cross.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it with the spin to sweeper cover for a single.
A couple to end! Another short one, Sohail stays leg side of the ball and guides it through point for another couple.
Shorter and on middle, Azam goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for one.
Uses his feet and then eases it down to long on for one.
Flatter and outside off, this is guided through point for two.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Overthrow! Once again Sri Lanka being very sloppy in the field. Sohail pushes it towards the fielder at cover. The fielder picks the ball up and makes a wild throw towards the keeper who does not collect it and a single is taken.
Shehan Jayasuriya is back into the attack. 8-1-35-0 his figures so far.
Slower one outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
This is angled into the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On off, Azam looks to drive but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
One more delivery on the pads, it is a slower one. Azam works it wide of fine leg and takes an easy two.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On the fuller side, Haris pushes it to mid off.

Drinks break. Pakistan are going smoothly at the moment with Babar Azam, in particular, looking in fine form. He will be eyeing a century here and the hosts will be looking to get a score in excess of 300, at least. The Lankan bowlers have started to leak runs now and need to pull things back, especially at the death.

SIX! That is huge! Second of the over. An expensive return into the attack for Hasaranga. This is a poor ball. It is short and it sits up to be hit. Azam goes back and pulls it high and handsome over the mid-wicket fence. 17 from the over. A huge one.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
A single as this is hit through mid on.
SIX! Azam takes full toll of the freebie. He has dismissed the bowler here. It is a quicker one on off, Azam stands tall and lofts it with utmost ease over the long on fence.
Uses his feet and hits it down to long on for one. It is also a no ball as Sri Lanka have one extra fielder outside the ring. Free Hit coming up.
Slightly shorter again outside off, Azam goes back and slaps it through covers for one.
Flatter and on off, Azam guides it to point.
Wanindu Hasaranga is back into the attack. 6-0-30-2 his figures so far.
BEATEN! Another full ball, this time it is outside off. Sohail looks to drive but gets beaten.
Very full, it is driven back to the bowler.
Follows the boundary with a single as this is worked through mid-wicket. Good batting.

FOUR! That though is a fine, fine effort from the fielder. Just brilliant from him but his effort went in vain. Kumara looks to bowl a yorker but ends up bowling a full toss on the pads. Azam flicks it with immaculate timing. It races through towards deep square leg. The fielder there dives to his right and manages to get a hand to it but due to the force on the ball, it hits the hand and still trickles towards the rope.
Shortish and outside off, Haris opens the face of the bat and hits it down to third man for one.
On the off pole. Azam plays it late down towards third man for one.
Fractionally short, Azam goes back and looks to pull but the ball skids through, it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for one.
Azam comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. He keeps it out.
Flatter and around off, Sohail stays leg side of the delivery and pushes it through covers for one.
On middle, the batter works it on the leg side and takes a quick run.
Sohail comes down the track and eases it to long off for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.

FOUR! 16th ODI fifty for Pakistan's next big thing - Babar Azam! He continues to score runs at will. Gorgeous cover drive from him as he punishes a full delivery outside off. The placement and timing are top class. Babar raises his bat to acknowledge the Karachi crowd. Can he convert it into a big one?
Helps it off his pads to mid-wicket and picks up a single.

NOT OUT! Kumara delivers a full length ball on middle and leg, angling down, Azam tries to flick but misses and it goes off his pads to square leg. They cross for a leg bye as the bowler turns to appeal for an lbw. It's not entertained by the umpire and Sri Lanka decide to review it. The Ball Tracker finds it to be clipping the leg pole. Umpire's call.

DRS time! Shout for an lbw is not upheld by the onfield umpire. Is it going down the leg side? Let's find out. First up, Ultra Edge is used and it finds no wood. Ball Tracker then shows it to be clipping the leg stump. Umpire's call.

In the air...but goes safely over the infield. Short in length and around off, Babar pulls it off his front foot but doesn't get it from the middle of his bat. It flies over mid-wicket and travels safely to the deep. They manage to come back for the second.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Beaten! Kumara speeds in and serves a length ball in the channel outside off. The ball moves away from the left-hander with the angle and Sohail pushes inside the line. Misses.
Lahiru Kumara is back on.
A dot to end as Azam works this one to mid-wicket.
Flatter and outside off, this one turns back in. Azam does well to keep it out.

Well bowled but poor effort in the field. Jayasuriya sees Azam coming down the track and slows it up drastically on the leg pole. Azam looks to flick but it goes off the inner half towards short fine leg. The batters go for one. Thirimanne, the skipper, there takes his eyes off the ball at the very end and misfields. An extra run conceded.
Sohail comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. He pushes it to long on for one.
On middle, Azam works it through mid-wicket for one.
Floats it up on off, Azam defends it out.
A dot to end! A yorker on middle, Haris jams it out towards mid-wicket. A better over from Udana.
Azam shuffles across and then works this one through square leg for a single.
Leading edge but safe! This lands on the leg pole. It angles away. Azam closes the face of the bat early as he tries to flick. It goes off the leading edge towards point.
A slower ball outside off, Haris waits for it and then guides it to the left of keeper for one.
Good length and on off, Haris defends it nicely.
A little too straight, this is worked through square leg for one.
Azam retains strike as he works it through square leg for one.
Flatter and on middle, Haris pushes it down to long on and gets to the other end.
On the pads, this is worked around the corner for one.
On off, this is pushed towards cover where the fielder fails to stop it despite a dive. A single taken.
On middle again, Sohail works it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Shortish and close to off, Babar leans back and steers it through cover-point. The sweeper cover fielder charges across to his left and stops the ball at the last moment. Saves two. 8 from the over.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Azam shuffles across the stumps and glances it behind square leg for a couple of runs.
A lovely off drive by Babar but he finds the mid off fielder.
A length ball outside off, angling away, Babar tries pushing it through covers but the face of his bat opens up at the point of contact and he ends up playing it to point.

FOUR! Delightful! He won't miss out again. Udana pitches it up and outside off, Babar leans into his straight drive and crunches past the bowler. It races down and reaches the fence in no time. Glorious.
Play and a miss! Full in length and angling away from the batsman, Babar tries to drive it through the line but is beaten for pace and bounce.
Isuru Udana returns into the attack.
Sohail works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Fires it on middle, SJ keeps it out.
A single as this is hit down to long on.
Drop and run! On off, Sohail taps it towards cover and gets to the other end.
Azam flicks it with the turn through square leg and gets to the other end.
This is fired into the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
Shehan Jayasuriya is back into the attack. 4-1-19-0 his figures so far.
Shorter and outside off, Sohail cuts it through point for a single.
A couple! On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side for two.
A googly on middle, this is kept out.
A low full toss on middle, Azam hits it through mid on for one.
Loopy ball on off, Azam strokes it to covers.
On middle, this is kept out.
Angling down the leg side, it's nudged to fine leg for one. 10 coming from this over!

Shortish and outside off, Babar taps it down on the off side and looks for a run. But he quickly realizes that the ball has gone too quick to the cover fielder and hence sends Haris back. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Poor this time from the Sri Lankan skipper. Nuwan sprays out a fuller length ball outside off, Babar reaches out for it and drives it down towards mid off. Thirimanne there is late in getting down and the ball goes right through his legs to the fence behind.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Slower delivery, on the shorter side around middle and leg, Babar drags it down towards long leg. Shehan Jayasuriya does well near the fence to save a certain boundary. The onfield umpire confirms the same from the third umpire.
Straighter delivery, Haris works it wide of mid on and the ball races away. Lahiru Thirimanne gives the chase and pulls it back just before the fence. Saves a run for his side.
Loopy ball on off, Azam strokes it to covers.
Sohail works it to the left of the bowler who dives over the ball and a single is taken down towards long on.
Flatter and outside off, this is guided to point.
Floats it up on off, this is kept out.
On middle, it is kept out.
A single as this is hit down to long off.
Sad news for Sri Lanka! As a mark of respect to its former manager, Michael De Zoysa, who passed away yesterday, the players are wearing black arm-bands.
Well played! This is outside off, Azam waits for it and then guides it late down to third man for one.
Slightly behind a length on off, Azam looks to drive it on the up but ends up mistiming it towards mid off.
One more delivery on a length and around off, Azam is solid in defense.
One more ball on a length and on off, Azam keeps it out.
On middle, Azam defends it out.
Slightly fuller on off, Sohail strokes it through covers for one.
Nuwan Pradeep is back!
Knocks a full ball down to long on and opens his account with a single. 4-0-24-2, so far the leggie has done an exceptional job.
Haris Sohail is the new man in.

OUT! Wicket number 2 goes down and Fakhar is distraught. Another success for Hasaranga. He fools the batsman with a well-disguised googly. He pitches it on a fuller length close to off, Fakhar without picking it clears his front leg for a big heave across the line. But the ball spins away from him, takes the outside half of his bat and loops in the air. Udana stationed at mid off moves across to his right and takes a fantastic catch.
Uses the spin to his advantage and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, Zaman moves back and punches it back in the direction of the bowler. Hasaranga moves to his left to stop the ball but fails and it travels to long on. A single is taken.
Spinning down the leg side, Fakhar helps it off his pads towards backward square leg. The fielder there dives but fails to stop the ball. They take a couple of runs.
Fuller and flighted around leg, Babar eases his drive down through mid on for a single.
An appeal but nothing from the umpire. This is on the pads, the batter looks to whip it but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal but not given.
Good running! On a length and around off, Azam drops it towards cover and takes off. Zaman responds quickly and the two complete the run with ease.
On the fuller side, Zaman mistimes it towards mid on but gets a run.
One more dot as this is once again guided to point.
One more dot! This is on off, Zaman guides it towards point.
Shortish and on the body, Zaman looks to pull but misses to get hit near the box.

Fifty for Zaman! His 12th in ODIs. A good start to the series for him. He was in need of some runs and he has a chance to score a big one here. This is just outside off, Zaman plays it late towards short third man for one.
The googly on middle, the batter goes back and keeps it out.

FOUR! Smashed! Second boundary in the over. This is floated up outside off, it is fuller in length. Zaman goes up and over extra cover for a boundary. He hit that against the spin but did so nicely. He moves onto 49.
This is on middle, it is worked towards square leg for a single.
Well fielded! This is floated up on off, Azam strokes it to the left of the bowler who dives and stops a run.
SIX! Poor ball and Azam takes full toll of it. It is way too short, Azam picks the length early, he rocks back and pulls it hard over the mid-wicket fence.
On a length and around leg, Fakhar tries flicking but misses. It goes off his pads to mid-wicket.
Full length ball just outside off, Babar drives it delightfully down the ground but only for a run as the mid off fielder cuts it off with a dive to his right.
Beaten on this occasion! Almost a nick. Kumara lands it on a good length outside off, Babar tries to dab it towards third man but it keeps low and beats his bat.
FOUR! Big cheer from the crowd for Babar's first boundary. Short in length around off, Azam pulls it off his front foot and finds the gap at mid-wicket. Brilliant.
Lahiru Kumara pulls out as Babar Azam is not happy with something behind the bowler's arm.
Shortish and close to off, Babar tries to run it down to third man but the fielder from first slip intervenes and keeps the batsmen at their respective ends.
Back of a length delivery on off, Babar goes on the back foot and punches it towards the backward point fielder.

Drinks break. It's been a watchful start from Pakistan. Their openers have done the job yet again and now it's up to the current pair and those to follow to capitalize. Sri Lanka haven't bowled badly but haven't managed to pick wickets at regular intervals either. To their credit, they have kept things tight. The middle phase is going to be crucial for both sides. There is spin on offer. Let's see how the next segment pans out.
A dot to end another good over from the leggie. On the pads, it is worked to short fine leg.
On the pads, it is worked around the corner for one.
Azam uses his feet but does not get to the pitch of the ball. He pushes it back to the bowler.

Beauty! Turn, bounce, that ball had everything but not the outside edge. This lands on off and then spins away. Azam looks to defend but gets beaten. The keeper takes it on the second attempt and makes only a muted appeal but nothing from the umpire. The slip fielder was more vocal in his appeal to be honest. Nothing doing as far as the umpire is concerned.
Uses his reach, makes it into a full toss and then sweeps it through square leg for one.
Floats it up on off, Zaman defends it out.
A misfield and a run! This is shorter and on off, it is pushed back towards the bowler who does not stop it and it goes down to long off for one.
Slower through the air on middle, Zaman defends it out.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on and Azam gets to the other end.
Slower through the air on middle, this is eased down to long off for one.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Flighted and on off, turning away, Azam tries pushing it through the line but it takes the outside edge and rolls towards backward point. A single is taken. Successful first over for Wanindu!
Fullish and on off, driven back to the bowler.
The new star of Pakistan cricket, Babar Azam comes out to the middle to bat at number 3.

OUT! Three reds and Imam is given lbw! Beautifully bowled delivery by Hasaranga. He loops it up in the air and lands it around off. Imam is stuck inside the crease as maybe he expected it to skid away from him. But to his surprise, it spins back into him and strikes him on the front pad. The appeal is made but the umpire shakes his head. Sri Lanka take the referral after their skipper consults with the bowler and keeper. The replays roll in. Ultra Edge shows no bat and then the Ball Tracker confirms that it's hitting the stumps. First breakthrough for Sri Lanka!

Appeal for an lbw! It's not given. Sri Lanka have opted for the referral. Is there any inside edge? Ultra Edge detects nothing. Is it too high then? Ball Tracker shows that it's hitting the stumps. First strike for Sri Lanka!

Slight miscommunication but no harm done! Tossed up ball around leg, Imam clips it off his pads to square leg and steps out of the crease. Seeing that, Fakhar comes charging down but only to be sent back.
Well played! Shortish and on off, skidding away, Imam plays a late cut past short third man for a couple of runs.
Fuller and flatter on middle, Fakhar eases it down through mid on for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga into the attack now.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
One more single as Imam pushes it through mid on.
On middle, this is defended.
Flatter and on off, Zaman pushes it past the bowler and down to long off for one.
A very loopy ball on off, Imam pushes it down to long off for one.
Flatter and outside off, Imam guides it to short third man.
Danushka Gunathilaka is into the attack.
In the air... but safe! Two in the end! Zaman looks for the big slog but is in no position to play it. He gets a top edge which lands safely in the deep mid-wicket region. Gives him two.
On the pads, this is worked around the corner for one.
On the off pole this time, Imam shows the full face of the bat and defends it out.
Zaman now waits for the ball to come to him and then just opens the face of the bat to guide it down to third man for one.
Just outside off, Imam opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for one.
Good running! Fuller in length and on off, Imam looks to drive but it goes off the outer half through point. They take the first one quickly and go for the second. Complete it easily.
One more ball on a length and around off, this is guided to the man at point.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Almost drags it on! Not a good shot this. It is just outside off. Not a lot of width on offer. Zaman looks to guide it down to third man away from the body. He gets an inside edge which deflects onto the pads and then goes closely past the leg pole.
Shortish and outside off, it is guided down to third man for a run.
On the shorter side and around off, Zaman chops it towards cover for one.
FOUR! That is a nothing delivery. Just easy pickings for the batter. It is short and down the leg side. All Zaman had to do is get bat on ball. He does so and helps it to the fine leg fence.
On the shorter side on off, Zaman now guides it towards third man for one.
On the pads, it is worked down to fine leg for one.
Shortish and around off, Zaman plays it late and down to third man for one.
On the pads, this is worked towards mid-wicket. The batters go for a run, the fielder fumbles and a single is made easy. 50 up for Pakistan, solid start for them.
Shehan Jayasuriya is placed at a wide slip position. Wait, he is now getting moved in front of square leg.
Shorter and on middle, it skids through. Imam is hurried into the pull, he gets an inside edge onto the body.
On the fuller side, this is worked through mid-wicket. Imam calls for two and gets it. Good running!
Powerplay 2 time! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Length delivery just outside off, Imam guides it to third man and keeps the strike with himself. 47/0 in Powerplay 1, a good beginning from Pakistan!
Slower one this time, fuller and on off, Fakhar tries to drive it through the line but it takes the inner half of his bat and rolls to mid off. They steal a quick run.
Shortish and on off, this time Imam opens the face of his bat and runs it down to third man for one.
Back of a length delivery closer to off, Imam stays back to cover the line and then blocks it down safely.
Misses out there, Imam! Plenty of width on offer outside off, it's short in length, Imam reaches out but ends up guiding it straight to backward point.
Pitches it up and around off, Imam drives it off his front foot but finds the short cover fielder.
Fakhar continues to struggle in putting away a delivery on the leg stump. Is beaten for pace and takes a blow on the thigh pad.
Almost an action replay of the last ball. Shorter and on the body, Zaman looks to go over the leg side again but misses to get hit on the pads. Kumara's pace seems to be hurrying up the batsman.
On the pads again, Zaman tries to whip it but misses again to get hit on the pads.
On off, it is kept out.
Shorter and on the pads, Zaman looks to heave but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
Shortish and outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Lahiru Kumara is on!
A dot to end another good over for Pakistan! This is on off, Zaman plays it late towards point. 9 coming from it!

FOUR! Creamed! Second boundary in the over and this one is right off the middle. Fuller and on off, Zaman leans into it and strokes it through the right of mid off and the ball races away to the fence.
Slapped but no runs! A dipping full toss, a slower one outside off. Zaman hits it hard but straight to covers.
Bowls it on a length this time on off, Zaman keeps it out.

FOUR! Top delivery but a boundary. The bowler is unlucky there. Udana bowls a yorker on the leg stump. Zaman looks to jam it out but the ball hits the inner half, goes past short fine leg and to the fence.
On middle, Imam works it through square leg for one.
Isuru Udana is on now.

FOUR! Not off the middle but still a boundary! Zaman makes room and gets a full ball. He does not quite get under it but hits it well enough to clear mid off. It flies over the fielder and races away to the fence. The last ball spoils the over.
Shorter again and on middle, Imam goes back and works it through square leg for a single.
On the pads, this is worked around the corner for one.
Slower through the air and on off, Zaman is solid in defense.
Zaman makes room but the bowler angles it into the batter. Zaman keeps it out.
Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
So a good comeback by the bowler after going for a boundary! Shorter and on middle, this is defended onto the ground.
One more ball on a length, blocked.
Goes back to bowling length and lands it on middle, this is defended solidly.
FOUR! Runs flowing now! That is exquisite! Zaman holds the pose for the cameras too. This is very full and on middle, Zaman shows the full face of the bat and creams it through mid on for a boundary.
Good length and outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Good length from around the wicket. Imam keeps it out nicely.
A dot to end a good over for Pakistan. On middle, this is kept out.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
On the pads again, this is worked to the fielder at short fine leg.
On the pads, Imam looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Smart batting! Follows the six with a single as this is pushed down to long on.

SIX! All the way! First biggie of the game. Excellent shot this by Zaman. He uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it with the angle over the mid-wicket fence. Clever shot as he knows it is not turning and he just went with the angle.
Mid off comes in, long on drops back.
This is wider outside off, Imam does not fiddle with it.

FOUR! Beautiful shot! They had 5 fielders on the off side but Imam pierces the gap with ease. This is slightly fuller and outside off, Imam leans into the stroke and caresses it through cover-point for a boundary. First of the game.
Length again and on off, Zaman strokes it on the up towards mid off and a single is taken.
Zaman looks to drive this one on the up but fails to time it properly. It goes towards point again.
Well fielded! Slightly fuller again around off, Zaman drives it square on the off side. The fielder at point dives to his left and stops it. Saves two at least.
Edgy run! Fuller and outside off, Imam looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
One more run as this is worked with the angle through mid-wicket. Three overs done and Pakistan have begun quite watchfully here.
On middle, this is defended.
Confusion but safe! Zaman works it towards mid-wicket and wants a run. Imam is hesitant to go for it but does so eventually and in the end, makes it in with ease.
This is fired on the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
A little turn there but the length is shorter. Imam goes back and keeps it out.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They have run through for a single.
A couple to end! Once again Pradeep is guilty of bowling a straighter line. Imam works it through mid-wicket and takes two.
Zaman is underway now! A little too straight again, FZ works it through mid-wicket for one.
A full toss but Fakhar does not take toll of it. It is on middle, Zaman pushes it past the bowler but mid on gets across to his right and stops it nicely.
Pakistan are underway! This is a little too straight. Imam-ul-Haq works it towards fine leg and gets to the other end.
Slightly fuller this time and on off again, Imam pushes it to mid off.
Back of a length and on off, Imam guides it to point.
Nuwan Pradeep to bowl with the second new ball.
A maiden to begin with by Jayasuriya. On middle, Zaman works it to mid-wicket.
Stump-to-stump line. Zaman defends it.
One more in-drifter from outside off. Zaman looks to force it through the off side but it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
Clever bowling again! Sees Zaman come down the track and shortens the length. FZ defends it.
Good ball! This starts from outside off, it drifts back in. Zaman defends outside the line and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Starts off with a flatter delivery but on the shorter side and outside off. Zaman cuts but straight to point. Misses out there does Zaman. That was a scoring opportunity.

Done and dusted with the National Anthems! We are all set for the action to begin. The Sri Lankan players make their way out to the middle. The Pakistan openers Imam-ul-Haq and Fakhar Zaman stride out too. It is spin to begin with as Shehan Jayasuriya has the first new ball in hand. Here we go...
It is time for the National Anthems! Sri Lanka will sing theirs first and then it will be hosts' turn.

SRI LANKA (PLAYING XI) - Lahiru Thirimanne (C), Sadeera Samarawickrama (WK), Danushka Gunathilaka, Avishka Fernando, Oshada Fernando, Shehan Jayasuriya, Dasun Shanaka, Isuru Udana, Wanindu Hasaranga, Nuwan Pradeep, Lahiru Kumara.
PAKISTAN (PLAYING XI) - Fakhar Zaman, Imam-ul-Haq, Babar Azam, Haris Sohail, Iftikhar Ahmed, Sarfaraz Ahmed (WK/C), Imad Wasim, Wahab Riaz, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Amir, Usman Shinwari.
TOSS - Pakistan win the toss and have elect to bat first.

The wait is finally over for the Pakistan fans to watch a game on home soil after a long time. After the last game got called off due to rain, we have excellent news to begin with - THE SUN IS OUT! It is bright and sunny and we should surely have a full match starting on time. Hello and welcome everyone. It is now a 2-game series so winning the first game will mean an unassailable lead. The Pakistan side will be the firm favourites and they will be eager to make their fans' wait worth with a win. The Lankans, on the other hand, have quite a few new names who will also be hungry to make a mark for themselves. Let's hope we have a cracker of a contest. Stay tuned for more...
